title: The *Local* Veto
dek: Voters in 10 states decide on 34 data center projects today. OpenAI won't say how many tokens you're buying. The build-out is ahead of the permit.

stories.label: local ballot measures on data center restrictions in 10 states
stories.headline: Every measure decided in 2026 limited development. Tonight changes the baseline.
First government to budget AI Biosecurity as its own institutional category.

still_signal: At every layer today, a decision about AI's physical footprint was made before affected parties had a voice. Ballot measures are the exception. Everywhere else, someone set the terms first.
